key_insight: AVS-HOBO improves constrained quantum optimization by remapping invalid states into usable ones, reducing penalties and making VQE more reliable for TSP on NISQ hardware.
engineering_relevance: The encoding offers a more practical way to run combinatorial optimization on present-day quantum devices by improving feasibility and scalability without changing the underlying problem.
method: Built a HOBO Hamiltonian with an efficient binary representation for TSP.
Introduced an all-valid-state HOBO (AVS-HOBO) scheme using cyclic mapping to remove one penalty term and reuse otherwise invalid states.
Evaluated VQE in noiseless NISQ-style simulations and on real quantum hardware with error-mitigation comparisons.
evidence_signal: The paper tests TSP instances up to 20 cities and reports comparisons of energy convergence, approximation ratio, tour-length ratio, and feasibility ratio across encodings and devices.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on device noise, architecture, and error-mitigation choice, so hardware results may vary across platforms.
paper_title: All-valid-state HOBO encoding for constrained combinatorial optimization on NISQ devices
